data.text:
Around 11,000 cops are set to be deployed to secure the conduct of the third Trillion Peso March, a protest against flood control corruption, on February 25, which falls on EDSA People Power Revolution anniversary.

At a press briefing on Friday, PNP spokesperson Police Brigadier General Randulf Tuaño said the police force is fully prepared to ensure that all related events and public gatherings are peaceful and orderly.
